details: This package is a self-declared dependency-confusion test artifact. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends a single HTTPS POST to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc with a JSON body containing only install metadata: the package name, the host name, the install directory, the working directory, the npm/node user-agent string and the protocol, plus an X-Beacon-Package header identifying the package. TLS certificate verification is disabled for the request (rejectUnauthorized: false) so it works against a self-signed VPS certificate. The package contains no other logic beyond an inert shim; it reads no environment values, credentials, tokens or files, and uploads no package or project content. IOCs: hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc
